UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 2991 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 29TH MARCH, 2022 
 
LEGISLATION ON POPULATION CONTROL 
 
2991.  SHRI NARESH BANSAL :  
 
Wil
l the MINISTER OF HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state: 
(a) Whether it is a fact that the increasing population of the country is such a menace which 
has hampered the development cycle for a long time and we are facing shortage of resources 
even when they are available in ample quality; 
(b) the steps being taken by Government in this direction and whether there is any plan to make 
law over it;  
(c) if so, the detail thereof; and 
(d) if not, the steps being taken to find out the solution to this problem through positive 
discussion and deliberation? 
 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND                            
FAMILY WELFARE 
(DR. BHARATI PRAVIN PAWAR) 
 
 
(a) to (d
): Increase in population leads to constraints on resources. It is in this context that 
Government of India has initiated multiple interventions to address this issue, namely:  
1. Mission Parivar Vikas  is implemented in 13 states for substantially increasing access to 
contraceptives and family planning services.  These states are the seven high focus states 
(Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Assam) 
and six North-Eastern states (Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Tripura, Nagaland 
and Mizoram).   
 
 
301

 
 
 
2. Expanded Contraceptive Choices : The current contraceptive basket comprising 
Condoms, Combined oral contraceptive pills, Emergency contraceptive pills, Intrauterine 
contraceptive device (IUCD) and Sterilization is expanded with inclusion of new 
contraceptives namely Injectable contraceptive and Centchroman (Chhaya). 
3. Compensation scheme for sterilization acceptors  which provides compensation for loss 
of wages to the beneficiary for sterilization.   
4. Post-partum Intrauterine contraceptive device  (PPIUCD) services are provided post 
delivery. 
5. Scheme for Home Delivery of contraceptives  by ASHAs at doorstep of beneficiaries i s 
in place. 
6. Family Planning Logistics Management Information System (FP-LMIS): A dedicated 
software to ensure smooth forecasting, procurement and distribution of family planning 
commodities across all the levels of health facilities. 
 
Efforts of the Government have been instrumental in reining in the growth of population, and the 
following progress has been achieved: 
 The Total Fertility Rate (TFR) declined to 2.0 in 2019-2 1 (NFHS 5) which is below 
replacement level.  
 31 out of 36 States/ UTs have achieved replacement level fertility (NFHS 5). 
 The Modern Contraceptive usage has increased to 56.5% (NFHS 5). 
 The Unmet Need for Family Planning is only 9.4% (NFHS 5). 
 The Crude Birth Rate (CBR) has declined to 19.7 in 2019 (SRS).

MEDICAL EDUCATION FOR EVACUEES FROM UKRAINE 
 
2993  DR. SANTANU SEN: 
 
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the number of students who returned from Ukraine and who were enrolled in medical courses 
there; 
 
(b) the number of total vacant medical seats in India including 2nd, 3rd and 4th-year seats, 
course-wise and academic term-wise; 
 
(c) whether Government plans to accommodate these students in the vacant medical seats in the 
country; and 
 
(d) if so, the details thereof, and if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE 
MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND 
FAMILY WELFARE 
(DR. BHARATI PRAVIN PAWAR) 
 
(a) to (d ): Section 14 of the NMC Act, 2019 prescribes conduct of a uniform entrance 
examination namely National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) to all medical educational 
institutions at undergraduate and post-graduate level. Also, Clause 8 (iv) of Eligibility 
Requirement for Taking Admission in an Undergraduate Medical Course in a Foreign Medical 
Institution Regulation, 2002 provides for that any Indian citizens/Overseas citizen of India 
intending to obtain primary medical qualification from any medical institution outside India, on 
or after May 2018, shall have to mandatorily qualify the National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test 
(NEET) for Admission to MBBS course. The result of the NEET shall deem to be treated as the 
Eligibility Certificate for such persons and no separate permission required from NMC.  
Therefore, data of students going abroad to pursue MBBS is not maintained centrally. 
306

NMC, for the betterment of Indian student pursuing medical studies abroad, vide circular dated 
04.03.2022 has allowed foreign medical graduates with incomplete internship due to such 
compelling situation which is beyond their control such as Covid 19 to complete their remaining 
part of internship in India subject to the condition that such candidates must have cleared FMGE 
(Screening Test), which is mandatory for Indian students with foreign medical qualification to 
practice medicine in India.

308

(c) & (d) The Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY) aims at correcting regional

projects of upgradation of GMCIs have been approved under the Scheme.

UNCERTAINTY IN MEDICAL STUDIES DUE TO COVID-19 PANDEMIC 
 
2996  SHRI ABDUL WAHAB: 
 
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether it is a fact the National Medical Commission (NMC) does not recognise online 
education for medical courses; 
 
(b) if
 so, whether Government will direct NMC to revoke the decision to include students whose 
medical course is in uncertainty due to the COVID-19 pandemic; and 
 
(c) whether any Panel or Commission has been formed so far to resolve the complaints and 
interruptions of medical studies of students studying abroad? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND 
FAMILY WELFARE 
(DR. BHARATI PRAVIN PAWAR) 
 
(a) to (c ): In view of the unforeseen circumstances emerged due to COVID-19, the National 
Medical Commission (NMC) has already validated and approved online theory classes for 
MBBS students during COVID period, supplemented by practical and clinical training as per 
current curriculum in all MBBS subjects in colleges/ institutions.  
Moreover, NMC, for the betterment of Indian student pursuing medical studies abroad, vide 
circular dated 04.03.2022 has allowed foreign medical graduates with incomplete internship due 
to such compelling situation which is beyond their control such as Covid 19 pandemic etc. t o 
complete their remaining part of internship in India subject to the condition that such candidates 
must have cleared FMGE (Screening Test), which is mandatory for Indian students with foreign 
medical qualification to practice medicine in India.

NEED FOR COVID-19 BOOSTER VACCINATION DOSES 
 
2998. SHRI SUBHAS CHANDRA BOSE PILLI 
   
  Will the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Government is aware of any study that has been conducted on the need for COVID-19 
Booster vaccination doses; 
(b)  if so, the details thereof; 
(c) whether Government is planning booster vaccination doses for its citizens; 
(d) if so, the details thereof; and 
(e) if not, the reasons therefor? 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE 
(DR. BHARATI PRAVIN PAWAR) 
(a) to (e) A study has been conducted by Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) to examine the 
effect of booster dose of Covaxin which shows increase in the levels of neutralizing antibodies against 
SARS-CoV-2 after the booster dose. The study report can be accessed a 
https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2022.01.05.22268777v1. International data available on 
booster doses of AstraZeneca/Covishield suggests 3-4 times increase in neutralizing antibody levels after 
administration of third dose of AstraZeneca/Covishield.  
As per the recommendation of the National Technical Advisory Group on Immunization (NTAGI), 
precaution dose is administered to the Health Care Workers (HCWs), Front Line Workers (FLWs) and 
persons aged 60 years & above since 10 th January,2022. As on 24 th March 2022, a total of 2.21 crore 
precaution dose of COVID-19 vaccines have been administered.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3002 
ANSWERED ON 29.03.2022 
 
ELECTRICITY FOR ALL VILLAGE HOUSEHOLDS 
 
3002. SHRI M.V. SHREYAMS KUMAR 
 
Will the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government proposes to provide electricity in each household of every village of 
the country through solar energy scheme; 
(b)  if so, the details thereof, State-wise; and 
(c)  the names of companies through which the said scheme is being implemented, State-wise? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POWER 
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) to (c) No Sir. There is no scheme to pro vide electricity in each household of every village of 
the country only through solar energy. Government of India had launched Pradhan Mantri Sahaj 
Bijli Har Ghar Yojana – “Saubhagya” in October, 2017 with the aim to achieve universal 
household electrifica tion by providing last mile connectivity and electricity connections to all 
households in rural and all poor households in urban areas across the country . The provision for 
solar based standalone systems to electrify un-electrified households  was only for houses and 
hamlets where grid extensi on was neither feasible nor cost effective. Under this provision, 4.16 
lakh households were electrified through solar based standalone systems up to 31.3.2021.  
Based on the requests from the States, elect rification of additional 1.35 lakh households, through 
solar based standalone systems has been sanctioned by the Government.  
Under Saubhagya and additional households sanctioned under DDUGJY a total of 4,70,415 
off grid households have been electrified through solar energy. State wise details, including 
the details of implementation agencies, are provided in the Annexure.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA

RAJYA SABHA  
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3003 
ANSWERED ON 29.03.2022 
NATIONAL GREEN HYDROGEN POLICY 
3003. SHRI VAIKO 
          SHRI M. SHANMUGAM 
 
Will the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government recently releasedNational Green Hydrogen Policy; 
(b) if so, the highlights thereof; 
(c) whether any incentives are provided for potential manufacturers, generation companies and DISCOMS to 
boost large scale indigenous production of Green hydrogen; 
(d) if so, the details thereof; and 
(e) by when will the second part of the Policy be finalized and released and the sectors involved, the details 
thereof? 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POWER  
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
(a) to (d) Ministry of Power  have issued orders providing for  the waiver of inter-state transmission charges shall be 
granted for a period of 25 years to the producer s of Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia from the projects 
commissioned before 30th June 2025.  It also provides that  Green Hydrogen/Green Ammonia plants will be granted 
Open Access for sourcing of Renewable Energy within 15 days of receipt of application complete in all respect s the 
open access charges shall also be in accordance with the Rules. It  has been provided that Banking shall be permitted 
for a period of 30 days for Renewable Energy used for making Green Hydrogen / Green Ammonia.  The other 
provisions in the order are: 
 
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy will establish a single portal for all statutory clearances and permissions 
required for manufacture, transportation, storage and distribution of Green Hydrogen / Green Ammonia. The 
concerned agencies/authorities will be requested to provide the clearances and permissions in a time -bound manner, 
preferably within a period of 30 days from the date of application. 
 
Connectivity, at the generation end and the Green Hydrogen / Green Ammonia manufacturing end, to the ISTS for 
Renewable Energy capacity set up for the purpose of manufacturing Green  Hydrogen / Green Ammonia shall be 
granted on priority under the Electricity (Transmission system planning, development and recovery of Inter State 
Transmission charges) Rules 2021. 
 
 Land in Renewable Energy Parks can be allotted for the manufacture of Green Hydrogen / Green Ammonia. 
 Setting up of Manufacturing Zones has been proposed.  Green Hydrogen / Green Ammonia production plant 
can be set up in any of the Manufacturing Zones. 
 Manufacturers of Green Hydrogen / Green Ammonia shall be allowed to set up bunkers near Ports for storage 
of Green Ammonia for export / use by shipping.   The land for the storage purpose shall be provided by the 
respective Port Authorities at applicable charges.  
 Renewable Energy consumed for the production of Green Hydrogen / Gr een Ammonia shall count towards 
RPO compliance of the consuming entity. 
 The Policy prescribes that the Distribution licensee shall only charge the cost of procurement as well as the 
wheeling charges and a small margin as determined by the State Commission for the Renewable Energy, 
purchased by manufacturers of Green Hydrogen / Green Ammonia. 
 
(e) In the Independence Day speech on August 15, 2021, Hon’ble Prime Minister announced the launch of National 
Hydrogen Mission and stated the goal to make India a global hub for Green Hydrogen production and export. 
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy has accordingly formulated a draft National Green Hydrogen Mission 
document, which is under finalization.

(c) the contribution of solar energy to the nation’s energy requirement? 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POWER 
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) The percentage of total electricity generated in the country powered by renewable sources 
(including large hydro) is 22.32% for the year 2021-22 (up to January-2022). 
(b) The Government has taken several steps to promote solar energy in the country. These 
include:- 
 permitting Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) up to 100 percent under the automatic route,  
 waiver of Inter State Transmission System (ISTS) charges for inter-state sale of solar and 
wind power for projects to be commissioned by 30th June 2025,  
 declaration of trajectory for Renewable Purchase Obligation (RPO) up to the year 2022,  
 setting up of Ultra Mega Renewable Energy Parks to provide land  and transmission to 
RE developers on a plug and play basis,  
 schemes such as Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-
KUSUM), Solar Rooftop Phase II, 12000 MW CPSU Scheme Phase II, etc, 
 laying of new transmission lines and creating new sub-station capacity under the Green 
Energy Corridor Scheme for evacuation of renewable power, 
 notification of standards for deployment of solar photovoltaic system/devices,  
 setting up of Project Development Cell for attracting and facilitating investments, 
 Standard Bidding Guidelines for tariff based competitive bidding process for 
procurement of Power from Grid Connected Solar PV and Wind Projects.  
 Government has issued orders that power shall be dispatched against Letter of Credit 
(LC) or advance payment to ensure timely payment by distribution licensees to RE 
generators. 
 Conducting skill development programmes to create a pool of skilled manpower for 
setting up, operation and maintenance of RE projects. 
(c): The contribution of solar energy to the nation’s electricity requirement for the year 2021-22 
(upto January-2022) is 4.69%.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3008 
ANSWERED ON 29.03.2022 
 
INFORMATION ON WASTE-TO-ENERGY PLANTS 
 
3008. SHRI ABIR RANJAN BISWAS 
Will the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to state: 
(a) the  number of waste -to-energy plants currently operating in the country and the amount of 
Biogas/Bio CNG/Power that is being generated from them, State-wise and product-wise; 
(b) whether incineration is also used as a technique in waste-to-energy plants; 
(c) if so, how the harmful and polluting gases and other micro pollutants are handled after 
incineration; and 
(d) the amount of waste that is being incinerated currently in the country for waste-to-energy? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POWER 
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) A total of 249 Waste-to-Energy plants, 819 Biomass Power plants and 50.8 lakhs small Biogas 
plants have been set up in the country to generate Power/Biogas /BioCNG.  Details of Waste to 
Energy plants, Biomass Power plants and small biogas plants set up in the country as on 28.02.2022 
are given in the Annexure. 
 
(b) & (c)  In Waste to Energy plants, incineration is used for recovery of energy from  dry and 
combustible wastes such as municipal solid waste  (MSW) having calorific value of more than 
1500kCal/kg. Emission of pollutants arising from incineration of MSW is handled by deploying 
pollution control devices, Flue Gas treatment (FGT) and regulating temperature in the combustion 
chamber to achieve the emission limits as prescribed in  Solid Waste Management Rules 2016 . 
Further, Online Emission Monitoring Systems  are also installed in the plant which are monitored 
by State Pollution Control Boards (SPCB’s). 
 
(d) As on 28.02.2022, 11 plants with a total cumulative installed capacity of 132.1 MW for power 
generation from Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) have been set up in the country. These plants have 
capacity of processing approximately 11,000 tons of MSW/day to generate electricity.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3009 
ANSWERED ON 29.03.2022 
GREEN HYDROGEN 
3009. SMT. VANDANA CHAVAN 
  
Will the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government plans to waive off intra-State transmission charges on Green 
hydrogen for cost reduction; 
(b) whether a framework for Viability Gap Funding for creation of hydrogen storage 
infrastructure has been instituted, and if so, the State/UT-wise details thereof, and if not, 
the reasons therefor; 
(c) whether any new nodal agency for Green hydrogen is proposed and if so, the details 
thereof; and 
(d) whether a Green Hydrogen Consumption Obligation on the lines of Renewable Purchase 
Obligation is proposed, and if so, the details thereof? 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POWER 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
(a) The determination of tariff for intra-state transmission is under the purview of State Electricity 
Regulatory Commissions as per section 86 (1) (a) of the Electricity Act, 2003. As per Ministry of 
Power’s order no. 23/02/2022-R&R dated 17 February 2022, the waiver of inter-state transmission 
charges shall be granted for a period of 25 years to the producer of Green Hydrogen and Green 
Ammonia from the projects commissioned before 30th June 2025. 
 
(b) to (d) In the Independence Day speech on August 15, 2021, Hon’ble Prime Minister announced 
the National Hydrogen Mission and stated the goal to make India a global hub for Green Hydrogen 
production and export.  
 
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy has accordingly formulated a draft National Green 
Hydrogen Mission document. The draft National Green Hydrogen Mission document proposes a 
framework inter alia for support to pilot projects including for hydrogen storag e infrastructure; 
demand creation through suitable mandates in identified sectors; and an institutional framework 
for implementation of the Mission.

FUNDS SANCTIONED UNDER PM-KUSUM SCHEME 
 
3011. SHRI AYODHYA RAMI REDDY ALLA 
 
Will the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  the details of the funds sanctioned, allocated and utilised under the Pradhan Mantri 
Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM) scheme during the last 
three years; 
(b)  the total number of beneficiaries under the scheme since its inception, State-wise; and 
(c)  the average income generated for farmers, State-wise under the scheme? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POWER 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) & (b) PM-KUSUM Scheme is a demand driven Scheme and allocations are made based on 
the demand received from States.  State -wise details of the capacities allocated, number of 
beneficiaries and funds released under the Scheme till 28.02.2022 are placed at Annexure.  
 
(c) PM-KUSUM Component-A for installation of grid -connected solar power plants up to 2 
MW and Component -C for solarization of existing agriculture pump provide farmers an 
opportunity to earn additional income by selling of power to the Distribution Companies. The 
additional income earned by farmers would vary from State to State and also within a State 
depending on factors such a solar insolation, electricity price offered by the Distribution 
Company and capacity of solar panels installed. Mos t of the projects under these components 
of the Scheme have been commissioned during the current year only and therefore, details 
related to additional income generated by farmers are yet to be reported by the State 
Implementation Agencies.

Will the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the details of all sources of renewable energy in Assam and West Bengal, district-wise; 
 (b) the details of all projects that are ongoing to generate renewable energy in Assam and West Bengal, 
district-wise; 
(c) the details of the estimated cost and timeline for completion of the above mentioned projects;           
(d) the details of the environmental impact surveys conducted before undertaking these projects; and 
(e) the details of how the country plans to be independent in terms of making solar panels given that it 
is highly dependent on imports from China? 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POWER 
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a): The source-wise and district-wise details of grid connected renewable energy capacity (including 
large hydro) installed in the state of Assam and West Bengal as on 28/02/2022 are given in the 
Annexure-I.  
 
(b) & (c): The source -wise and district -wise details of grid connected  renewable energy projects 
(including large hydro) under various stages of implementation in the State of Assam and West Bengal 
are given in Annexure-II. 
 
The capital cost per MW varies from Rs 4 to 10 Crore depending upon the type of renewable energy.   
 
(d): As per information provide by  Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change (MoEF&CC),  
Renewable energy projects such as solar power and wind energy projects are not covered unde r the 
ambit of Environment Impact Assessment (EIA) Notification 2006   and hence do not require prior 
environment clearance. However,  Solar photo Voltaic (PV) Power Projects, Solar Thermal Power 
plants and  Development of Solar Parks  shall follow the  environmental and statutory stipulations  
outlined in its OM no                     J-11013/41/2006-IA.II(I) dated 30th June 2011. 
(e): In order to incentivize domestic manufacturing of solar energy systems, the Government has taken 
a number of steps, including: 
(i) Modified Special Incentive Package Scheme (M -SIPS) Scheme of Ministry of Electronics & 
Information Technology. 
(ii) Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for High Efficiency Solar PV Modules. 
 (iii) Preference to ‘Make in India’ in Public Procurement in Renewable Energy Sector. 
(iv) Domestic Content Requirement (DCR) under schemes such as CPSU Phase-II, PM-KUSUM, Solar 
Rooftop Phase-II, etc. 
(v)  Imposition of Basic Customs Duty on import of solar PV cells & modules. 
 (vi) Discontinuation of Customs Duty Concession benefits on the items imported for initial setting up 
of the solar power projects with effect from 02.02.2021.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3014 
ANSWERED ON 29.03.2022 
 
TARGET OF MEETING ENERGY REQUIREMENTS 
 
3014. SHRI M. SHANMUGAM 
Will the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to state: 
(a) whether any review has been made on the target of meeting energy requirements from renewables 
and to advance it, due to pressure on oil procurement consequent upon Ukraine crisis; 
(b) if so, the details thereof; and 
(c) whether sustained efforts are being made to achieve the target of 75 per cent of energy 
requirements before 2032, if so, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POWER 
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) to (c): In accordance with Hon’ble Prime Minister’s announcement at COP26, Ministry of New and 
Renewable Energy is com mitted to achieving 500 GW of installed electricity capacity from non -fossil fuel 
sources by 2030. 
A total of 152.90 GW of renewable energy capacity projects (including large hydro) have been installed in 
the country as on 28 -2-2022. Further, p rojects of 72.61 GW capacity are under various stages of 
implementation and 21.11 GW capacity are under various stages of bidding.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY 
RAJYA SABHA  
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3015 
ANSWERED ON 29.03.2022 
 
VILLAGE ELECTRIFICATION IN RAJASTHAN AND MAHARASHTRA  
 
3015. SHRI HARSHVARDHAN SINGH DUNGARPUR 
 
Will the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to state:  
 
(a)  the details of target set and achieved so far under village electrification programme through renewable energy 
sources in Rajasthan and Maharashtra; 
(b)  the steps the Ministry has envisaged to achieve the target fixed for the Financial Year; and  
(c)  the details of monitoring mechanism regarding progress of the programmes? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POWER  
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) & (b) DDUGJY and Saubhagya schemes include provision of access to electricity  by Renewable Energy sources 
to un-electrified villages/habitations where grid connectivity is neit her feasible nor cost effective. Where electricity 
connection through grid connectivity is feasible and cost effective the access to electricity is given by grid 
connectivity.  
 
In the State of Maharashtra, since 2017-18, a total of 30538 off-grid home light systems in 191 villages were installed 
under SAUBHAGYA. In Rajasthan, the total number of Off-grid households electrified under DDUGJY was 43,711, 
while under Saubhagya, a total of 1,23, 682 households were electrified under Off-grid projects. 
 
Government of India has recently issued guidelines for electrification of any leftover un -electrified households 
identified before 31.03.2019 for covering these under Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS) through on-grid 
mode, or through schemes of Ministry of New and Renewable Energy through the off -grid mode. 
 
(c)The monitoring mechanism under DDUGJY and Saubhagya has been as under:  
 
(i) At the Central level, an inter -ministerial Monitoring Committee on DDUGJY headed by the Secretary, Ministry 
of Power, Government of India monitored the implementation of the scheme. Besides, the progress is reviewed with 
States / Power Utilities in Review, Planning and Monitoring (RPM) meetings of the Ministry of Power on a monthly 
basis. 
  
(ii) At State level, a Committee under the Chairmanship of Chief Secretary monitored the progress and resolved 
issues relating to implementation. Further, the progress was reviewed by the Chief Secretary of the r espective State 
on monthly basis and Secretary (Energy) on fortnightly basis. 
  
(iii) DISCOMs are primarily responsible and accountable f or ensuring quality of material  and work. State Power 
Utilities are required to  formulate comprehensive Quality Assuran ce (QA) & Inspection Plan with an objective to 
build quality infrastructure under the scheme. 
  
(iv) In addition to the in -house quality checks and processes followed by the DISCOMs, the nodal agency (REC) 
carry out concurrent inspection of works through T hird Party Quality Monitoring Agency i.e REC Quality Monitor 
(RQM) on sample basis. 
  
(v) At District level, (DISHA) District Development Coordination & Monitoring Committee meetings (under the aegis 
of Ministry of Rural Development) headed by senior-most Hon’ble Member of Parliament (Lok Sabha) of the district 
& other MPs of the district as co-chair with District Magistrate as Convener, reviewed the progress.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 3016
ANSWERED ON 29/0312022
SCHEMES/PROJECTS FOR IMPROVING INLAND WATER TRANSPORT
30I6. SI-IRI M. V. SHREYAMS KUMAR:
Willthe Minister of PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATERWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of various schemes and projects launched for improving inland water
transport in the country,
(b) the status of developing waterways in Kerala; and
(c) the present status of the project and the time by which the project is likely to be
commissioned?
ANSWER
MINISTER OF PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATERWAYS
(SHRI SARBANANDA SONOWAL)
(a) To promote inland water transport (lWT) in the country, I 1l National Waterways
(I.JWs) (including 5 existing and 106 new) were declared under the National Waterways Act,
2016. Based on the outcome of techno-economic feasibility and Detailed Project Reports
(DPRs) prepared for NWs, action plan has been formulated for 26 NWs which have been
found viable for cargo/passenger movement (Details at Annex-l). Development activities
have been initiated in the first 13 NWs out of these 26 NWs.
(b) & (c) The stretch from Kollam to Kottapuram with Champakkara & Udyogamandal
Canals (205 Km.) in Kerala was declared as National Waterway-3 (NW-3) in 1993 and
thereafter, it was further extended by 165 km from Kottapuram to Kozhikode in north along
with NW-8 (Alappuzha- Changanassery Canal) and NW-9 (Alappuzha- Kottayam-
Athirampuzha canal) under National Waterways Act, 2016. The present status of ongoing
development works in the National Waterway (NW)-3 in Kerala is at Annex-2.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA

RAJYA SABHA
UNSTARRED QUESTTON NO- 3020
ANSWERED ON 2910312022
DEATH OF CREW MEMBERS
3020. SHRI RAMKUMAR VERMA:
Will the Minister of PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATERWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any mechanism to monitor the pending cases of the Indian crew
members who lost their life during their service period on the private foreign cargoships/
vessels, ifso, the details thereof; and
(b) whether Government has any data with regard to the deaths of Indian crew members on
foreign ships/ vessels during the last two years, if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons
therefor?
ANSWER
MINISTER OF PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATERWAYS
(SHRI SARBANANDA SONOWAL)
(a) Yes Sir, as per Rule 5 (i) of Merchant Shipping (Recruitment and Placement of
Seafarers) Rules,2016 of the Merchant Shipping Act, 1958, the Recruitment and Placement of
Seafarers (RPS) service provider reports the incident or casualty on -board causing injury or
death, disappearance, loss overboard or homicide by or of an Indian National to the Director
General of Shipping at the earliest and not later than twenty four hours of the receipt of such
information. On receipt of the report as per the protocol followed by the Directorate General of
Shipping, the following actions are taken on each case:
i. Gather more information, if required, fiom the RPS providers.
ii. Take up the matter with the Indian Mission for providing necessary assistance as
required in the matter.
iii. To contact the Flag State and Port State authorities to carry out Marine Safety
investigation in accordance with the International Convention on the Laws of the Sea (SOLAS)
and Casualty Investigation Code of International Maritime Organization(lMO) and to furnish
the investigation report .
iv. Coordinate with P&l Club and Owners of the vessel for payment of death compensation
to Next of Kin (NOK) of the deceased.
Further, the Directorate has set up DG Communication centre (DG Commcentre) in
2004, acting as a Maritime Assistance Service (MAS) in accordance with IMO guidelines for
362

dissemination of information 24x7 to stakeholders in the shipping fratemity on safety and
security incident.
The information related to shipping incidents occurring at sea on board the Indian ships
globally and Indian nationals on board the Indian and a foreign vessel is shared with concerned
Govt. authorities /agencies and shipping companies /operators to initiate action at their end.
Each incident is handled and monitored by DG Commcentre in order to respond into the
incident by respective stake holder.
(b) Yes sir. As mentioned in part (a) of the question, the D G Commcentre set up by the
Directorate maintain data with regard to the deaths of Indian crew members on foreign flag
vessels. As per the records for the last two years a total of 188 cases had been reported.

TURNAROUND TTME FOR SHIPS IN THE COUNTRY
3026. SHRI ABIR RAN.IAN BISWAS:
Will the Minister of PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATERWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the ship Turnaround Time in the country is still more than one day
even after taking steps such as Central Port Authority (CPA) Act and revised Model
Concession Agreement (MCA);
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether any Indian port has cranes with the outreach required to handle large ships with
15000 Twenty-Foot Equivalent Unit (TEU);
(d) if not, whether Government is taking any step in that direction; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
ANSWER
MINISTER OF PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATERWAYS
(sHRr SARBANANDA SONOWAL)
(a)&(b) Average turnaround time for Vessels across Major Ports in India has improved
from 96 hours (4 days) in2014-15 to 55.67 hours (2.31 days) in202l. Similarly, average
turnaround time for container vessels at Major Sea Ports has improved from 41.16 hours
(1.74 days) in 2013-14 to 26.58 hours (1.10 days) rn202l-22 (upto February,2022). Further,
the MIV 2030 has target to bring the average tumaround time for container vessels to less
than 20 hours as per the best in class global benchmarks.The new Major Port Authority Act
2021 and Revised Model Concession Agreement 2021 would definitely help in bringing the
best in class technologies in poft operations to Major Ports through greater private
participation via PPP mode, which will fumher help in increasing efficiency at Major Ports.
(c),(d)&(e) Yes, Sir. Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority has crane handling facilities for
handling large container ships with 15000 TEU capacity.

UNS'I'ARRED QUES'l'tON NO- 3027
ANSWERED ON 2910312022
DEVELOPMENT OF NATIONAL WATERWAY-s
3027. DR. PRASHANTA NANDA:
Will the Minister of PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATERWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of proposed cargo terrninals at Talcher, Nasirabad, Balasore and
Rajnagar on National Waterway (NW-5);
(b) the details of funds sanctioned and expenditure made in this regard; and
(c) the details of Government's plarr to develop East Coast Canal (Geonkhali- Charbatia)217
km as aparl of NW-5?
ANSWER
MINISTER OF PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATE,RWAYS
(sHRI Sn RB^NANDA SONOWAL)
(a & b) A total lerrgth of 588 knr of Brahrnani delta, Ivlatai River & East Coast Canal (DCC)
rvas declared as National Waterway in November 2008. Inland Waterways Authority of India
(lWAl) completecl the preparation of a Detailed Project Report (DPR) on NW-5 and the DPR
was further updated in 2016. The updated DPR recommended development of NW-5 as detailed
hereunder
(i) Phase-l: Paradip ro Dharnra and Mangalgadi to Pankapal: 212KM.
(ii) Phase-ll: Pankapal to Talcher: 120 KM.
(iii) Balance portion inctuding East Coast Canal (ECC) in subsequent Phase.
IWAI has initiated development of Phase-I. DPR has not recommended construction of a
cargo terminal at Raj Nagar. Terminal at Talcher comes under Phase-ll. Hence, no action plan is
formulated for terminals at these 2 locations. Nasirabad and Balasore are not on the banks of
NW-5 and hence no terminal is proposed at these locations by IWAI. Hence, no fund has been
sanctioned and hence no expenditure incurred in this regard'
(c) With regard to East Coast Canal (ECC) (256 KM), there are number of bridges having
low vertical and horizontal clearances and the stretch is subjected to heavy siltation and
encroachment by the public between Dhamra to Geonkhali (256 KM)' As per DPR, the ECC
crosses several rivers such as, Halclia, Rasulpur, Subarnarekha, Panchapada, Budhabalanga in its
entire tength and it is assessed that 23 locks are required to provide a passage for barges from
one level to other. In view of the above and as per DPR recommendations, the stretch of East
Coast Canal from Geonkhali to Charbatia is not proposed for development.

AVAILABILITY OF ELECTRICITY IN EVERY HOUSEHOLD 
 
3030 # SMT. KANTA KARDAM: 
 
 Will the Minister of POWER 
be pleased to state: 
(a)  the details of progress made under the scheme to provide electricity to every household in the 
country; 
 
(b)  whether cent percent target of the scheme has been achieved in Uttar Pradesh and if so, the 
details thereof; 
 
(c)  whether any target has been fixed to ensure round the clock availability of electricity; and 
 
(d)  if so, the details thereof? 
A N S W E R 
 
THE MINISTER OF POWER AND NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY  
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) & (b) : The Government of India launched Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana – 
Saubhagya in October, 2017 with the objective to achieve universal household electrification by 
providing electricity connections to all un-electrified households in rural areas and all poor 
households in urban areas in the country. Under the scheme, as on 31.03.2019, all households were 
reported electrified by the States, except 18,734 households in Left Wing Extremist (LWE) affected 
areas of Chhattisgarh. Subsequently, seven States namely Assam, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, 
Karnataka, Manipur, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh reported that around 19.09 lakh un-electrified 
households, identified before 31.03.2019, which were unwilling earlier, have later on expressed 
willingness to get electricity connections. Government approved the electrification of these 
households in  August, 2019. A total of 2.817 crore households including 91,80,571 households of 
Uttar Pradesh were electrified since the launch of Saubhagya, upto 31.03.2021. Thereafter,  some 
States reported that 11,83 ,870 additional households (including 3,34,652 households of Uttar 
Pradesh),  which were unwilling earlier, were now willing for electrification. These were also 
sanctioned. Against this, 4,40,893 households have been electrified  as on 15.03.2022. Accordingly, 
a total of 2.86 crore households have been electrified, details  of which State-wise including Uttar 
Pradesh are enclosed as Annexure.

In addition, Government of India have recently issued guidelines for electrification of 
any leftover un-electrified households identified before 31.03.2019 prior to Saubhagya for covering 
these under Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS). 
(c) & (d) :  All the States and Union Territories (UTs) have signed MoUs with the Central 
Government to ensure 24x7 power supply to all households, industrial & commercial consumers and 
adequate supply of power to agricultural consumers w.e.f. 1st April, 2019 onwards.  
As per information made available by States on National Power Portal (NPP), the

fund releases under the scheme are linked to initiation of reforms and achievement of results that

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA

RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.3031 
ANSWERED ON 29.03.2022 
 
PAYMENT DUE OF DISCOMS TOWARDS VARIOUS POWER GENERATORS 
 
3031  SHRI NARAIN DASS GUPTA:  
 
 Will the Minister of POWER 
be pleased to state: 
(a)  whether there is a huge debt of power DISCOMs towards Central power generation stations, IPPs and 
renewable energy generators currently; 
 
(b)  the reason for the increased cases of surmounting dues and worsening financial performance of the 
DISCOMs; 
 
(c)  whether steps have been taken by Government to ascertain the accountability; and  
 
(d)  whether the fiscal mismanagement on the part of DISCOMs has affected the operations of the other 
partners in the power sector value chain? 
 
A N S W E R 
 
THE MINISTER OF POWER AND NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY  
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) :     As per data provided by the power sector Generating companies, on the PRAAPTI Portal, at the 
end of February, 2022, a total amount of Rs.1,00,931 Crore is due from the DISCOMs. The details are placed at 
Annexure. 
  
(b) :  The main reasons for the increase in outstanding dues payable to GENCOs and poor financial 
performance of DISCOMs include high AT&C loss; tariffs not reflective of costs; delayed and inadequate 
payment of outstanding subsidies as well as Government Departmental dues by the State Governments and 
weak corporate Governance practices. 
 
(c) :  Government of India ha ve made several interventions to improve and operational efficiencies 
of DISCOMs linked to reform measures including Liquidity Infusion Scheme (LIS); additional borrowing of 
0.5% of GSDP to States linked to power sector reforms; introducing additional prudential norms for lending by 
Power Finance Corporation (PFC) Limited and REC Limited based on performance of utilities; and launching 
Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS). All these measures link the financial assistance to DISCOMs 
and States with power sector reforms aimed at improving the financial condition of DISCOMs; and also for 
increasing accountability of States and DISCOMs.  Central Government generation companies regulate power 
supply in case of persistent non-payment of power dues. 
 
(d) :  Poor liquidity arising out of the adverse financial position of DISCOMs not only causes 
problems to consumers in terms of poor power supply; but also causes problems upstream in the power sector 
value chain. Cash strapped DISCOMs find it difficult to pay their creditors, including Generating Companies, 
who in turn are not able to pay for Coal supplies and Railways freight, as well as salaries to their Staff and 
repayment of Bank Loans taken for the construction of the plant.

The

NATIONAL MISSION FOR ENHANCED ENERGY EFFICIENCY (NMEEE) 
 
3037  SHRI AYODHYA RAMI REDDY ALLA:  
 
 Will the Minister of POWER 
be pleased to state: 
(a)  the current status of the implementation of the National Mission for Enhanced Energy 
Efficiency (NMEEE) and various schemes under this including the Perform, Achieve and 
Trade (PAT) scheme and Market Transformation for Energy Efficiency (MTEE); 
 
(b)  whether PAT cycles III and IV have achieved their targets, if so, the deta ils thereof; and 
 
(c)  the status of implementation of PAT Cycle VI (2020-2023)? 
 
A N S W E R 
 
THE MINISTER OF POWER 
AND NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY  
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
 
(a) to (c) 
: The current status of the implementation of the National Mission for Enhanced 
Energy Efficiency (NMEEE) and various schemes under this including the Perform, Achieve and 
Trade (PAT) scheme and Market Transformation for Energy Efficiency (MTEE) is as under: 
 
NATIONAL MISSION FOR ENHANCED ENERGY EFFICIENCY (NMEEE):- National 
Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency (NMEEE) is one of the eight missions under the National 
Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC). Perform, Achieve and Trade (PAT) is the flagship 
programme under the mission implemented by Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) under the aegis 
of Ministry of Power. PAT scheme aims at reducing Specific Energy Consumption (SEC) i.e. 
energy use per unit of production for Designated Consumers (DCs) in energy intensive sectors, with 
an associated market mechanism to enhance the cost effectiveness through certification of excess 
energy saving which can be traded. The excess energy savings are converted into tradable 
instruments called Energy Saving Certificates (ESCerts) that are traded at the Power Exchanges. 
Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) is the market regulator for trading of ESCerts 
and Power System Operation Corporation Limited (POSOCO) is entrusted with the responsibility of 
the Registry. The two Power Exchanges such as India Energy Exchange (IEX) and Power Exchange 
India Limited (PXIL) provide the trading platform where the Designated Consumers (DCs) who fall 
short of their compliance, bid for purchase of ESCerts. 
 
...........2.
 
 
398

- 2 - 
 
PAT Scheme is implemented in cycles of 3 years each where the Designated 
Consumers (DCs) are assigned SEC reduction targets. Upon verification of their performance in the 
assessment year by third party verifying agencies, the issuance or obligation to purchase ESCerts is 
carried out by BEE after scrutiny of the performance.  
 
(i) PAT Cycle –I: PAT cycle –I aimed at reducing the SEC of 478 Designated Consumers in 8 
sectors viz. Aluminum, Cement, Chlor- Alkali, Fertilizer, Iron & Steel, Paper & Pulp, Thermal 
Power Plant and Textile. Implementation of the first cycle of PAT had resulted in energy savings of 
8.67 million tonnes of oil equivalent (MTOE) and translating into emission reduction of about 31 
million tonnes of CO2. 
 
(ii) PAT Cycle –
II: PAT Cycle II wa s notified with effect from 1st April, 2016 and was 
completed on 31st March 2019. Under this cycle, SEC reduction targets were notified to 621 DCs 
from 11 energy intensive sectors (eight sectors and three new sectors namely Refineries, Railways 
and DISCOMs). Implementation of PAT cycle -II has resulted into total energy savings of about 
14.08 MTOE translating into avoiding emission reduction of 66.01 million tonne of CO2.
 
 
(iii) PAT Cycle III: PAT cycle-III commenced with effect from 1st April 2017 after the decision 
of notifying PAT scheme on a rolling basis was taken. PAT cycle -III aimed to achieve an overall 
energy consumption reduction of 1.06 MTOE for which targets were notified to 116 Designated 
Consumers from six sectors viz. Thermal Power Plant, Cement, Aluminium, Pulp & Paper, Iron & 
Steel and Textile. PAT Cycle –III was completed on 31 st March 2020 and implementation of this 
cycle has resulted in energy savings of 1.745 MTOE.  
 
(iv) PAT Cycle IV: PAT cycle –IV commenced with effect from 1 st April 2018. A total of 106 
DCs with an estimated energy consumption reduction target of 0.6998 million tonnes of oil 
equivalent were notified. These DCs were from 8 sectors consisting of 6 existing sectors of PAT 
cycle -I and two new sectors namely Petrochemicals and Commercial Buildings (Hotels). The 
assessment year of these DCs was April –
July 2021 which was affected by the outbreak of the 
Pandemic due to COVID19 and thus was extended to April –July 2022 vide notification S.O. 3510 
(E) dated 27th August 2021. 
  
(v) PAT Cycle V: PAT cycle –V commenced with effect from 1st April 2019. Under PAT cycle 
– V, 110 DCs from the existing sectors of PAT i.e. Aluminum, Cement, Chlor-Alkali, Commercial 
Buildings (Hotels), Iron & Steel, Pulp & Paper, Textile and Thermal Power Plant were notified. The 
estimated energy consumption of these DCs is 15.244 MTOE and it is targeted to get a total energy 
savings of 0.5130 MTOE. 
 
(vi) PAT Cycle –
VI: PAT Cycle-VI commenced with effect from 1st April 2020. Under PAT 
Cycle-VI, 135 DCs from six sectors, i.e. Cement, Commercial buildings (hotels), Iron and Steel, 
Petroleum Refinery, Pulp and Paper and Textiles, were notified. With implementation of PAT cycle 
–
VI, it is expected to achieve a total energy savings of 1.277 MTOE. These 135 DCs are under 
process of implementation of various energy efficiency measures to meet their notified targets. 
 
(vii) PAT Cycle –VII: PAT cycle –VII has been notified in October 2021 for the period 2022-23 
to 2024-25 wherein 509 DCs have been notified with overall energy saving target of 6.627 MTOE. 
 
…………3.  
399

 
- 3 - 
 
 
Market Transformation for Energy Efficiency (MTEE):  MTEE aims for accelerating the shift to 
energy efficient appliances in designated sectors through incentives and innovative business models. 
Under MTEE,  the following programmes were introduced for the promotion of energy efficient 
products in the market:-  
 
(i) Bachat Lamp Yoja na (BLY):  The programme was developed for replacement of 
inefficient bulbs with Compact Fluorescent Lamps (CFLs). BLY involved support to LED 
deployment under “Unnat Jyoti by Affordable LEDs for All (UJALA)” by providing 
technical assistance to partner agencies such as Energy Efficiency Services Limited (EESL) 
and Rural Electrification Corporation (REC). Under BLY, 29 million bulbs were replaced 
with CFL resulting into energy saving of 3.598 billion units/ year. 
 
(ii) Super-Efficient Equipment Program (SEEP):  This programme was designed for 
market transformation of super-efficient appliances by providing financial stimulus 
innovatively at critical point/s of interventions.  
 
(iii) Following programme 
is being implemented by EESL for market transformation: 
 
 Unnat Jyoti by Affordable LEDs for All (UJALA): UJALA program was launched 
on 5 th January, 2015 for replacement of incandescent lamps with LED (Light-Emitting 
Diode) bulbs, in order to promote energy efficiency in the country. Under the said scheme , 
EESL, provides LED bulbs to domestic consumers at a low cost. LEDs have a relatively 
longer life and are highly energy efficient as compared to incandescent bulbs and CFLs 
(compact fluorescent lamps), thus saving both energy and costs in the medium term. EESL 
with support of stakeholders was able to achieve reduction in procurement price from        
Rs.
 310 per 7W bulb in 2014 to Rs. 38 per 9W bulb in 2016.  
 
As on February 2022 , EESL has distributed 36.79 crore LED bulbs, 72.18 lakh LED tube 
lights and 23.59 lakh energy efficient fans across the country under UJALA program.

DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS 
 
RAJYA SABHA  
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3038  
ANSWERED ON 29 MARCH 2022 
 
IMPACT OF SURGE IN THE PRICE OF CRUDE OIL ON INDIAN ECONOMY 
 
3038. Shri Neeraj Shekhar:  
 
Will the Minister of Finance 
be pleased to state:  
 
(a) whether Government has assessed the impact of unprecedented surge in the price of crude oil in the  
     international market on Indian economy;  
(b) if so, the details thereof;  
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and  
(d) the details of steps Government has taken to tackle the rise in price of crude oil in the international  
     market? 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR FINANCE  
(SHRI PANKAJ CHAUDHURY) 
 
(a) to (c) In April 2020, on account of subdued global demand because of COVID-19 induced 
restrictions, the price of Indian basket of crude oil dipped to $19.9/bbl. However, thereafter, the prices 
have been on an upward trend on account of lower than expected restorations of production by OPEC 
nations and increase in demand as the world economy recovers from disruption caused due to COVID-
19 and its variants. Recently, the geopolitical tension between Russia and Ukraine has led to further 
increase in price of crude oil in the international market. Government of India is closely monitoring 
the global price movement and its impact on India’s economy. 
(d): In a bid to stabilise rising oil prices, the Government of India agreed in November 2021, to release 
5 m
illion barrels of Crude oil from its strategic petroleum reserves, in consultation and parallelly with 
other major global energy consumers including the United States and Japan. Government has also 
been taking up the issue bilaterally, with crude oil producing countries, with OPEC and with heads of 
other international fora to convey India’s serious concerns over  crude oil price volatility, and India’s 
strong preference for responsible and reasonable pricing for consumer countries. In addition, 
Government has been focussing on augmenting domestic exploration and production of crude oil, 
improving the share of renewable sources in Indian energy basket, diversifying its crude basket by 
procuring crude from countries located at various geographical locations viz. Middle East, Africa, 
North America, South America etc. Further, to give a major thrust to Ethanol Blending Programme, 
Government of India through Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) are establishing 2G Ethanol plants 
across the country, which can help reduce oil imports. In the current Ethanol Supply Year (ESY) (Dec-
Nov) 2021-22, about 113 crore litres ethanol have been blended with petrol till 13.03.2022 thereby 
achieving 9.45% blending.

(c) & (d) :  A total of 25 projects were sanctioned under the scheme and the works have been 
completed.  Following steps were taken by Government for implementation of the projects and 
completion of projects:  
i. At Central level, inter-ministerial Monitoring Committee on DDUGJY headed by the 
Secretary, Ministry of Power, Government of India monitored the implementation of the 
scheme. Besides, the progress is reviewed with States / Power Utilities in Review, 
Planning and Monitoring (RPM) meetings of Ministry of Power on monthly basis. 
 
ii
. Time extension was granted as requested by the State to facilitate execution and 
completion of the scheme. 
Further, Government of India have approved the Revamped Distribution Sector 
Scheme- A Reforms-based and Results-linked Scheme on 20 July 2021 with an outlay of 
Rs.3,03,758 crore and a Gross Budgetary Support of Rs.97,631 crore from Government of India 
over a period of five years from FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26. The Scheme seeks to improve the 
operational efficiencies and financial sustainability of all DISCOMs/Power Departments 
excluding Private Sector DISCOMs by providing conditional financial assistance to DISCOMs 
for strengthening of supply infrastructure based on meeting pre-qualifying criteria as well as 
upon achievement of basic minimum benchmarks by the DISCOM evaluated on the basis of 
agreed evaluation framework tied to financial improvements.

DEMAND AND SUPPLY OF ELECTRICITY IN THE COUNTRY 
 
3040  SHRI IRANNA KADADI: 
 
 Will the Minister of POWER 
be pleased to state: 
(a)  whether Government has conducted any assessment of the supply and demand of 
electricity and if so, the details thereof, State/UT-wise; 
 
(b)  the estimated requirement of electricity in the country in the year 2022; 
 
(c)  the quantity of electricity likely to be available from the existing and ongoing projects in 
the country; 
 
(d)  whether Government has disbursed ₹ 8,000 crore to Karnataka for new power  
generation units to meet the shortage of electricity and if so, the details thereof, State/UT- 
wise; and 
 
(e)  the details of power projects to be set up by Government for the next five years, 
project-wise and State/UT-wise? 
 
A N S W E R 
 
THE MINISTER OF POWER 
AND NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY  
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) 
:  Central Electricity Authority (CEA) conducts Electric Power Survey (EPS) of the 
country every five years for estimating the electricity demand of the country on medium and long 
term basis as obligated under Section 73(a) of the Electricity Act, 2003. The 19 th Electric Power 
Survey (EPS) Report covers electricity demand projection for the year 2016-17 to 2026-27 as well as 
perspective electricity demand projection for the years 2031
-32 and 2036-37 for each State/UT. The 
details of State/UT-wise estimated/assessed electricity requirement of the country, from the year

“क ैं सर के  उपर्ार  के  वलए औषवियों पर जीएसटी की  अपेक्षाक ृ त कम  िरें”

क्या वित्त मंत्री यह बताने की  क ृ पा करेंगे  कक : 
 
(क ) िेश में क ैं सर के  उपर्ार  के  वलए प्रयोग की जाने िाली औषवियों पर ली जाने िाली 
जी.एस.टी. की  िरों का  ब्यौरा क्या है और क्या यह सर्  है कक  क ु छ ििाइयों पर अत्यविक िर 
से कर  लगाया जाता है; 
(ख) क्या सरकार  की  ‘कीट्रूडा’ जैसी ििाइयों को  किए गए कर  संबंिी लाभों का  विस्तार क ैं सर 
के  उपर्ार  में प्रयोग की  जाने िाली अन्य ििाइयों तक करने  की  भी मंशा रखती है;

लनगयानी कयता है ताकक मह सुलनर्ित ककमा जा सक े  कक उनकी (एभआयऩी) भें वृवद्ध वऩछरे 
फायह भहीनों क े  दौयान प्रर्लरत 10% से अलधक नहीॊ है। 
 
ऩूवव भें, एनऩीऩीए ने जनकहत भें डीऩीसीओ, 2013 क े  ऩैया 19 क े  अॊतगवत असाधायण शविमों 
को रागू कयते ह ुए, कदनाॊक 27 पयवयी , 2019 क े  आदेश एसओ 1041(ई) क े  अॊतगवत 42 कैंसय-
योधी दवाइमों क े  लरए व्माऩाय भार्जवन मुविकयण (टीएभआय) ऩय एक प्रायॊलबक ऩरयमोजना शुरू 
की थी।  हार ही भें, एनऩीऩीए ने क्रभश् कदनाॊक 3 जून 2021  के  एसओ 2161(ई) औय 13 
जुराई , 2021 क े  एसओ 2808 ई) द्वाया ऑक्सीजन कॉन्सेंट्रेटसव औय ऩाॊर् अन्म लर्ककत्सा 
उऩकयणों जैसे, (i) ऩल्स ऑक्सीभीटय, (ii) ब्रड प्रेशय भॉलनटरयॊग भशीन, (iii) नेफुराइजय, (iv) 
कडर्जटर थभावभीटय, औय (v) ग्रूकोभीटय क े  व्माऩाय भार्जवन को बी सीलभत कय कदमा है।  
 
  एनऩीऩीए द्वाया अऩनाई गई कामवप्रणारी वफक्री क े  ऩहरे वफॊद ु ऩय व्माऩाय भार्जवन को 
सीलभत कयती है, जो कक वव लनभावताओॊ द्वाया स्टॉककस्टों/ववतयक/सॊस्थानों आकद से वसूर ककमा  
जाने वा रा  भूल्म है। वव लनभावताओॊ एनऩीऩीए द्वाया कदए गए वफक्री का ऩहरा वफॊद ु पॉभूवरे क े  
आधाय ऩय एभआयऩी लनमत क यते हैं। वफक्री क े  ऩहरे वफॊदु ऩय भूल्म, ऩुयाने एभआयऩी औय 
सॊशोलधत एभआयऩी की सूर्ना वव लनभावताओॊ द्वाया एनऩीऩीए को दी जाती है।

(ग) सरकार द्वारा ग्राम स्तर क े  उद्यवमयों की संख्या बढाने क े  वलए क्या किम उठाये िा रहे हैं?

“एमएसएमई,‍एसएचजी‍और‍ग्राम‍स्तर‍ि े ‍उद्यकमयों‍िो‍किए‍गए‍‘मुद्रा’‍ऋण” ि े ‍सांबांध‍में‍श्री‍किजय‍
पाल‍कस ांह‍तोमर, माननीय‍सांसि‍सिस्‍ य‍द्वारा‍पूछे‍गए‍29‍माचच , 2022/8‍चैत्र, 1944 (शि) ‍ि े ‍राज्‍ य‍
सभा‍ताराांकित‍प्रश्न‍सांख्या‍*281‍ि े ‍उत्तर‍में‍उकललकित‍कििरण।‍ 
(ि):  मौिूिा विशावनिेशों क े  अनुसार, कोई भी व्यवि िो अन्यथा ऋण लेने क े  वलए पात्र है और विसक े  पास 
विवनमाचण, व्यापार, सेिा और कृ वर्ष से संबद्ध गवतविवधयों िैसे क्षेत्रों में गैर-कृ वर्ष आय अविचत करने संबंधी 
गवतविवधयों क े  वलए एक व्यिसाय योिना है, िह प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योिना (पीएमएमिाई) क े  तहत 10 लाख रू 
तक की ऋण आिश्यकताओं क े  वलये ऋण लेने का पात्र है। इस योिना क े  तहत ऋण तीन श्रेवणयों में विए गए 
हैं, अथाचत वशशु (50,000 रुपये तक का ऋण) , वकशोर (50,001 रुपये से 5 लाख रुपये तक का ऋण) और 
तरुण (5 लाख रुपये से 10 लाख रुपये तक का ऋण)। 
वपछले तीन वित्तीय िर्षच में योिना क े  तहत प्रिान वकए गए ऋणों का राज्य-िार वििरण संलग्न है।  
(ि) : श्रम और रोिगार मंत्रालय (एमओएलई) ने पीएमएमिाई क े  तहत रोिगार सृिन का अनुमान लगाने क े  
वलए राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर एक प्रवतिशच सिेक्षण वकया है। सिेक्षण क े  पररणामों क े  अनुसार, पीएमएमिाई ने लगभग 
3 िर्षों (यानी 2015 से 2018 तक) की अिवध क े  िौरान 1.12 करोड़ वनिल अवतररि रोिगार पैिा करने में 
मिि की। इस सिेक्षण क े  वनष्ट्कर्षों क े  अनुसार, समग्र आधार पर, वशशु श्रेणी क े  तहत ऋण, मुद्रा लाभावथचयों क े  
स्िावमत्ि िाले प्रवतष्ठानों द्वारा सृवित अवतररि रोिगार का 66% वहस्सा है, विसक े  बाि वकशोर (19%) और 
तरुण (15%) श्रेवणयां हैं। इसक े अलािा, विनांक 25.02.2022 की वस्थवत क े  अनुसार  योिना को आरंभ वकए 
िाने से लेकर पीएमएमिाई क े  तहत नए उद्यवमयों/खातों को 5.77 लाख करोड़ रुपये की रावश के 7.35 करोड़ 
से अवधक ऋण विए गए हैं। हाला ंवक, पीएमएमिाई योिना क े  तहत सृवित रोिगार क े  अिसरों क े  संबंध में 
आंकडे क ें द्रीय स्तर पर नहीं रखे िाते हैं। 
(ग): भारतीय ररििच बैंक (आरबीआई) द्वारा सूवर्त वकए गए अनुसार, 30 राज्यों / क ें द्रशावसत प्रिेशों में वित्तीय 
साक्षरता क े  वलए 1058 क ें द्र (सीएफएल) पररर्ावलत वकए गए हैं, िो 01 विसंबर, 2021 क े  वस्थवत क े  अनुसार  
3174 ब्लॉकों में सेिाएं िे रहे हैं।  ये वित्तीय साक्षरता क ें द्र अन्य बातों क े  साथ-साथ िेश क े  ग्रामीण लोगों क े  
बीर् उद्यमशीलता कौशल को बढािा िेने हेतु प्रवशक्षण कायचक्रम आयोवित करते हैं।इसक े  अलािा, ग्रामीण 
स्तर क े  उद्यवमयों को बढाने क े  वलए, बैंक अपने ग्रामीण स्िरोिगार प्रवशक्षण संस्थानों (आरएसईटीआई) क े  
माध्यम से ग्रामीण युिाओं क े  कौशल उन्नयन और उद्यवमता विकास पर ध्यान क ें वद्रत करते हुए प्रवशक्षण प्रिान 
करते हैं।  
आिीविका क े  अिसर पैिा करने क े  वलए, राष्ट्रीय कृ वर्ष और ग्रामीण विकास बैंक (नाबाडच), अपने सूक्ष्म उद्यवमता 
विकास कायचक्रमों (एमईडीपी) और आिीविका और उद्यम विकास कायचक्रमों (एलईडीपी) क े  माध्यम से ग्रामीण 
क्षेत्रों में एसएर्िी सिस्यों क े  वलए कौशल विकास को बढािा िे रहा है। नाबाडच एमईडीपी/एलईडीपी क े  माध्यम 
से एसएर्िी सिस्यों को कु शल बनाकर एसएर्िी सिस्यों को ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में सूक्ष्म उद्यम शुरू करने में सक्षम 
बनाने का प्रयास कर रहा है। 
इसक े  अलािा, ग्रामीण गरीबों को गैर-कृ वर्ष क्षेत्रों में ग्रामीण स्तर पर उद्यम स्थावपत करने में मिि करने क े  वलए, 
स्टाटच-अप ग्राम उद्यवमता कायचक्रम (एसिीईपी) को िीनियाल अंत्योिय योिना - राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आिीविका 
वमशन (डीएिाई- एनआरएलएम)) क े  तहत एक उप-योिना क े  रूप में लागू वकया िा रहा है। ग्रामीण विकास 
मंत्रालय (एमओआरडी) द्वारा िी गई सूर्ना क े  अनुसार, एसिीईपी क े  तहत अब तक कु ल 1.92 लाख उद्यमों 
को सहायता प्रिान की गई है।

आर्थथक कायय विभाग

तारांककत प्रश्न संख्या *283 
 
(विसका उत्तर मंगलिार, 29 मार्य, 2022/08 र्ैत्र, 1944 (शक ) को कदया िाना है ) 
 
भारतीय प्रवतभूवत और विवनमय बोडय (सेबी ) में व्यापार (ट्रेडडग) संबंधी घोटाला 
 
*283. श्री एम.िी. श्रेयम्स क ु मार: 
 
क्या वित्त मंत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे कक:  
(क ) क्या सरकार ने ‘सेबी’ क े  क ु छ पूिय और ितयमान शीर्य अवधकाररयों पर लगे इन गंभीर आरोपों पर ध्यान 
कदया है कक उन्होंने क ु छ दलालों को व्यापार प्रणाली में अवधमान्य रूप से पहुँर् बनाने की अनुमवत प्रदान की 
है; 
(ख)  यकद हाुँ, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(ग)  क्या यह आरोप लगाया गया है कक ‘सेबी’ क े  पूिय सीईओ क े  विरुद्ध िांर् में विलंब ककया गया है और यह 
िांर् काफी धीमी गवत से र्ल रही है; और 
(घ)  यकद हां , तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है और ितयमान में िांर् की वथथवत क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
वित्त मंत्री (श्रीमती वनमयला सीतारामन) 
 
(क ) से (घ): वििरण सभा पटल पर रख कदया गया है।  
  
427

 ‘भारतीय प्रवतभूवत और विवनमय बोडय (सेबी) में व्यापार (ट्रेडडग) संबंधी घोटाला’ क े  संबंध में श्री एम.िी. श्रेयम्स 
क ु मार द्वारा पूछे गए कदनांक 29.03.2022 को उत्तराथय राज्य सभा तारांककत प्रश्न सं. *283 क े  भाग (क ) से (घ) क े  
उत्तर में संदर्थभत वििरण 
 
(क ) से (घ): सरकार और सेबी को एनएसई सह -थथान क े  मामले में क ु छ वशकायतें प्राप्त हई थीं।  
 
इस मामले की िांर् क े  दौरान, यह देखा गया कक क ु छ थटॉक ब्रोकरों को ट्रेडडग प्रणाली में बेहतर पहंर् वमली हई 
थी। इस संबंध में र्ूक क े  वलए , एनएसई, एनएसई क े  पूिय सीईओ और शीर्य अवधकाररयों को प्रवतभूवत संविदा  
(विवनयमन ) (शेयर बािार और समाशोधन वनगम ) विवनयमन , 2012 क े  प्रासंवगक प्रािधानों क े  उल्लंघन क े  वलए 
विम्मेदार ठहराया गया है और उन पर मौकिक िुमायना और अन्य प्रवतबंध लगाए गए हैं। 
 
सीबीआई ने इस मामले में भारतीय दण्ड प्रकिया संवह ता, 1860, भ्रष्टार्ार वनिरण अवधवनयम, 1988 और 
सूर्ना प्रौद्योवगकी अवधवनयम, 
2000 की संगत धाराओं क े  तहत िर्य 2018 में एक मुकद्दमा दिय ककया है। सीबीआई 
की िांर् अभी भी र्ल रही है। सीबीआई ने सूवर्त ककया है कक इस मामले की तफतीश में पयायप्त प्रगवत हई है।

(जेनकोस) ; स्ितंत्र‍विद्युत‍उत्पादकों; और‍आरई‍जेनको ज‍की‍ देय ‍राशश यों‍की‍प्रिृवि‍अन ुबंध‍में‍दी‍गई‍

(ख) : ऐसे‍ कई‍ प्रािधान‍ हैं‍ जो‍ देय‍ राशशयों‍का‍ समय‍ पर‍ भुगतान‍ नहीं‍ करने‍ िाली‍ यूदटशलदटयों‍क े ‍

करने‍क े ‍शलए‍ददनांक‍2 8‍जून,‍2019‍को‍एक‍आदेश‍जारी‍ककया‍था।‍ यह‍आदेश ,‍जेनको‍ एिं‍डिस्कॉम‍

2883. श्री संजय सेठ:

(क ) देश में राष्ट्रीय होम्योपैथी संस्थान की र्ालू पररयोजनाओं का ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(ख) क्या यह सर् है कक सभी संस्थान अपनी वास्तववक और ववत्तीय प्रगतत के संदभच में वपछड़ रहे हैं;  
(ग)  यदद हां , तो तत्संबंधी राज्य-वार ब्यौरा क्या है; और 
(घ) सरकार र्ाल ू पररयोजनाओं को शीघ्राततशीघ्र पूरा करने के ललए क्या -क्या कदम उठा रही है ताकक लोगों 
के लाभ के ललए सभी संस्थाओं को कियाशील बनाया जा सके ? 
 
उत्तर 
आमुषयमांत्रीय(श्रीयभर्ाानांदयभोणोवाल) 
 
(क ): देश में होम्योपैथी चर्ककत्सा पद्धतत की पहुंर् बढाने के ललए राष्ट्रीय होम्योपैथी संस्थान (एनआईएर्), 
नरेला , ददल्ली की  राष्ट्रीय होम्योपैथी संस्थान, कोलकाता के एक अनुषंगी संस्थान के रूप में स्थापना की जा 
रही है, जजसमें माध्यलमक और त ृतीयक स्तर की  मुख्य रूप से होम्योपैचथक चर्ककत्सा के माध्यम से रोचगयों 
को  देखभाल सुववधा उपलब्ध कराने  के ललए 100 बबस्तरों वाला अस्पताल होगा। एनआईएर्, नरेला होम्योपैथी 
के ववलभन्न ववषयों में स्नातकोत्तर और डॉक्टरेट पाठ्यिम प्रदान करेगा।  
   
(ख) और (ग): जी हां ,यकोववड -19 के प्रभाव के कारण सभी संस्थानों की वास्तववक और ववत्तीय प्रगतत में देरी 
हुई है।  
 
(घ): राष्ट्रीय होम्योपैथी संस्थान, नरेला , ददल्ली पररयोजना की तनयलमत रूप से तनगरानी की जा रही है 
ताकक संस्थान का  यथाशीघ्र संर्ालन ककया जा सके।  लोगों के लाभ के ललए नरेला पररसर में नवंबर , 2020 से 
एक आउट पेशेंट ववभाग (ओपीडी) र्लाया जा रहा है।

2884. श्री राजेन्द्र गहलोत: 
  
क्या आयुष मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे ककिः 
 
(क ) क्या सरकार ने राजस्थान में आयुष सेवाओं के ब ुननयादी ढांर्े में स ुधार तथा इनकी स ुलभता में व ृद्धध 
करने के ललए कोई कदम उठाए हैं , यदद हां , तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(ख ) ववगत तीन वषों के दौरान राजस्थान में आय ुव ेद , यूनानी, प्राकृनतक धर्ककत्सा, हबचल दवाओं और आय ुष 
उद्योग के ववकास को बढावा देने के ललए राष्ट्रीय आय ुष लमशन (एनएएम ) के अंतगचत क्या -क्या पहलें 
की गई  हैं; और  
(ग)  सरकार द्वारा ववगत तीन वषों के दौरान उक्त बजटीय शीषच के अंतगचत ककतनी धनरालश खर्च की गई 
है? 
 
उत्तर 
आम ुषयमांत्रीय(श्रीयभर्ाानांदयभोणोवाल) 
 
(क ) से (ग): जन स्वास््य राज्य का ववषय होने के कारण , राजस्थान में आय ुष सेवाओं की अवसंरर्ना में 
सुधार करने और स ुगम बनाने की प्राथलमक जजम्मेदारी राजस्थान सरकार की है। तथावप, भारत सरकार ने 
आयुष पद्धनतयों के समग्र ववकास के ललए राजस्थान सदहत राज्यों /संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों के माध्यम से कायाचजन्द्वत 
राष्ट्रीय आयुष लमशन (एनएएम ) की क ें रीय प्रायोजजत स्कीम शुरू की है , जजसमें अवसंरर्नात्मक ववकास एवं 
आयुष सेवाओं तक पह ुुँर् भी शालमल है। राष्ट्रीय आयुष लमशन  अन्द्य बातों  के  साथ-साथ ननम्नललखखत  
कायचकलापों  के  ललए  प्रावधान करता  है :-    
 
(i) आयुष्ट्मान भारत के तहत आयुष स्वास््य एवं वेलनेस क ें र 
(ii) प्राथलमक स्वास््य क ें रों (पीएर्सी), सामुदानयक स्वास््य क ें रों (सीएर्सी) और जजला अस्पतालों 
(डीएर्) में आयुष सुववधाओं का सह -स्थापन 
(iii) मौज ूदा एकल राजकीय आय ुष अस्पतालों का उन्द्नयन 
(iv) मौज ू
दा सरकारी /पंर्ायत/सरकारी सहायता प्राप्त आयुष औषधालयों का उन्द्नयन /नए एकल औषधालयों 
की स्थापना 
(v) 50/30/10 बबस्तरों के एकीक ृत आयुष अस्पतालों की स्थापना 
(vi) राजकीय आय ुष अस्पतालों, सरकारी औषधालयों और राजकीय
/सरकारी सहायता प्राप्त लशक्षण 
संस्थागत आयुष अस्पतालों को जरूरी  औषधधयों की आप ूनतच 
439

(vii) आयुष जन स्वास््य कायचक्रम  
(viii) राज्य सरकार के स्नातक -पूवच और स्नातकोत्तर लशक्षण संस्थानों का उन्द्नयन। 
(ix) उन राज्यों में नए आय ुष महाववद्यालयों की स्थापना , जहां सरकारी क्षेत्र में आयुष लशक्षण संस्थानों 
की आवश्यकता है।  
राजस्थान राज्य सरकार के संसाधन प ूल/बजटीय आवंटन तथा राजस्थान राज्य सरकार से राज्य वावषचक 
कायच योजनाओं (एसएएपी ) के माध्यम से प्राप्त प्रस्तावों के अनुसार, ववगत तीन वषों 2018-19 से 2020-21 
के दौरान 7286.169 लाख रुपए का सहायता अन ुदान जारी ककया गया। राष्ट्रीय आय ुष लमशन के तहत 
राजस्थान में आयुष सेवाओं  के अवसंरर्नात्मक ववकास एवं पह ुुँर् सदहत एनएएम के ववलभन्द्न कायचकलापों के 
ललए अन ुमोददत रालश का ब्यौरा भांलग्नि पर ददया गया है।  
 
इसके अलावा , राष्ट्रीय आयुष लमशन के एएसय ू एंड एर् औषधधयों के  गुणवत्ता ननयंत्रण घटक के तहत, 
राजस्थान के अजमेर , जोधप ुर, उदयप ुर तथा भरतपुर में 04 राज्य सरकार आयुव ेद फाम ेलसयों को स ुदृढ करने 
के ललए वपछले वषों के दौरान अन ुदान ददया गया था।

भारत सरकार  
आयुष मंत्रालय 
 
राज्य मयभाा 
अताराांकितयप्रश्नयभां.य2885 
29 मार्च, 2022 को प ूछे जाने वाले प्रश्न का उत्तर  
 
आमुषयऔरयऔषधीमयउत्पादोंयिायननमाात 
 
2885. श्री सुजीत क ुमार:   
क्या आयुष मंत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंगे ककिः 
 
(क ) ववगत तीन वषों के दौरान प्रत्येक वषच संय ुक्त राज्य अमरीका सहहत ववदेशों में ननयाचत ककए गए आय ुष 
और औषधीय उत्पादों का देश-वार ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(ख ) क्या उक्त अवधध के दौरान आय ुष और औषधीय उत्पादों के ननयाचत में कमी आई है ;   
(ग)  यहद हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है और इसके क्या कारण हैं ; और  
(घ) सरकार द्वारा इस संबंध में क्या -क्या उपाय ककए गए हैं ? 
 
उत्तर 
आमुषयमांत्रीय(श्रीयभर्ाानांदयभोणोवाल) 
 
(क ):  ववगत तीन वषों के दौरान प्रत्येक वषच संय ुक्त राज्य अमरीका सहहत ववदेशों में ननयाचत ककए गए आय ुष 
और हबचल  उत्पादों का देश-वार ब्यौरा भांलग्नि में हदया गया है।  
 
(ख):   जी नहीं।  
 
(ग):   प्रश्न नहीं उठता।  
 
(घ):  मंत्रालय ने आयुष में अंतराचष्ट्रीय सहयोग को बढावा देने के ललए एक क ें द्रीय क्षेत्रक योजना (आईसी 
योजना) ववकलसत की है जजसके तहत आय ुष मंत्रालय आयुष उत्पादों और सेवाओं के ननयाचत को बढावा देने के 
ललए भारतीय आय ुष ववननमाचताओं /आयुष सेवा प्रदाताओं को सहायता प्रदान करता है ; आयुष धर्ककत्सा पद्धनत 
का अंतराचष्ट्रीय स्तर पर संवधचन, ववकास और मान्यता हदलाने में सहायता देता है ; हहतधारकों के बीर् बातर्ीत 
और अंतराच ष्ट्रीय स्तर पर आयुष के बाजार ववकास को बढावा देता है ; ववदेशों में आय ुष अकादलमक पीठों की 
स्थापना करके अकादलमक एवं अन ुसंधान को बढावा देता है और अंतराचष्ट्रीय स्तर पर आय ुष धर्ककत्सा 
पद्धनतयों के बारे में जागरूकता और रुधर् बढाने और उसे मजब ूत करने के ललए प्र लशक्षण कायचशाला/संगोजष्ट्ठयों 
का आयोजन करता है।   
 
आयुष मंत्रालय ने वैजश्वक स्तर पर आयुव ेहदक दवाओं को बढावा देने की हदशा में ननम्नललखखत कदम 
उठाए हैं: 
 
 मंत्रालय ने बाहरी देशों के साथ पारंपररक धर्ककत्सा और होम्योपैथी के क्षेत्र में सहयोग के ललए 25 
अलग -अलग दे शों के साथ समझौता ज्ञापनों पर हस्ताक्षर ककए हैं। 
 सहयोगात्मक अन ुसंधान /अकादलमक सहयोग श ुरू करने के ललए अंतराचष्ट्रीय संस्थानों के साथ 32 
समझौता ज्ञापनों पर हस्ताक्षर ककए गए हैं। 
442

 ववदेशों में आय ुष अकादलमक पीठों की स्थापना के ललए अंतराचष्ट्रीय संस्थानों के साथ 14 समझौता 
ज्ञापनों पर हस्ताक्षर ककए गए हैं।  
 आयुष मंत्रालय ने 34 बाहरी देशों में 38 आयुष सूर्ना प्रकोष्ट्ठों की स्थापना के ललए सहायता प्रदान 
की है।   
 "आयुष ननयाचत संवधचन पररषद " को कॉरपोरेट कायच मंत्रालय के सहयोग से  आयुष मंत्रालय के तहत 
04.01.2022 को कंपनी अधधननयम 2013 की धारा 8 (4) के तहत पंजीक ृत ककया गया है , ताकक 
ववदेशों में आय ुष उत्पादों के पंजीकरण , ववदेशों में बाजार अध्ययन और अन ुसंधान गनतववधधयां श ुरू 
करने में आने वाली बाधाओं से ननपटा जा सके।  
 आयुष मंत्रालय अपने अंतराचष्ट्रीय अध्येताव ृवत्त/छात्रवृवत्त कायचक्रम के तहत भारत के प्रम ुख       
संस्थानों में आयुष पाठ्यक्रम शुरू करने के ललए ववदेशी नागररकों को छात्रव ृवत्त प्रदान करता है।  
 आयुव ेद के माध्यम से कोववड -19 के ननवारण पर नैदाननक अन ुसंधान अध्ययनों के ललए लंदन स्क ूल 
ऑफ हाइजीन एंड रॉवपकल मेडडलसन (एलएसएर् एंड टीएम ), यूके और फ्रैंकफटचर इनोवेशनजेंरम 
बायोटेक्नोलोजी जीएमबीएर् (एफआईजेड ), फ्रैंकफटच जमचनी के साथ समझौता ज्ञापनों पर हस्ताक्षर 
ककए गए हैं।  
 आयुष मंत्रालय ने लोगों को को ववड से बर्ाने और स्वस्थ रहने के बारे में अंग्रेजी के साथ -साथ 08 
अन्य ववदेशी भाषाओं में एडवाइजरी जारी की।  
 आयुष मंत्रालय बाहरी देशों के ननयामकों को आय ुष शैक्षक्षक प्रलशक्षण प्रदान करता है।  
 एएसयू एंड एर् उत्पादों के मानकों की ववश्वसनीयता बढाने के ललए आय ुष मंत्रालय ने क्य ूसीआई के 
सहयोग से गुणवत्ता प्रमाणन कायचक्रम यथा, आयुष माकच और प्रीलमयम माकच ववकलसत ककया है।  
 वाखणज्य मंत्रालय ने एमएआई योजना के जररए आय ुष उद्योग को प्रमुख व्यापार मेलों , व्यापार 
प्रनतननधधमंडलों में भाग लेने और हलाल , कोशर , गैर-जीएमओ प्रमाणन, यूएसपी एनएफ खाद्य 
प्रमाणन आहद जैसे प्राकृनतक उत्पाद प्रमाणपत्रों की प्रनतपूनतच करने के ललए भी सहायता दी।  
 आयुव ेद, लसद्ध और यूनानी और होम्योपैथी दवाओं के ननयाचत को स ुववधाजनक बनाने के ललए 31 
आयुव ेहदक दवा वव ननमाचताओं को डब््य ूएर्ओ-जीएमपी  (सीओपीपी) हदया गया है।

भारत सरकार  
आयुष मंत्रालय 
 
राज्य मयभाा 
अताराांकितयप्रश्नयभां.य2886 
29 मार्च, 2022 को प ूछे जाने वाले प्रश्न का उत्तर  
 
प्रस्तावितयडिजिटलयप्लैटफॉर्मयर्ेंयआमुिेदिियउपचारयऔरयआरोग्मयि ें द्रोंयिोयशामर्लयकिमायिाना 
 
2886. श्री संभाजी छत्रपती: 
  
क्या आयुष मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे ककिः 
 
(क ) क्या सरकार प ूरे ववश्व में जरूरतमंद मरीजों की मदद और मागचदर्चन करने के ललए प्रस्ताववत डिजजटल 
सूर्ना साइट में आयुव ेददक उपर्ार और आरोग्य क ें द्रों को र्ालमल करने का ववर्ार रखती  है; 
(ख) यदद हां , तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है;   
(ग)  क्या देर् के लोग डिजजटल प्लैटफॉमच पर अपलोि की गई जानकारी का लाभ उठाने के ललए हकदार 
होंगे; और  
(घ) ‘हील इन इंडिया ’ कायचक्रम र्ुरू करने में ककतना समय लगेगा ?  
 
उत्तर 
आम ुषयर्ांत्रीय(श्रीयभर्ामनांियभोणोिाल) 
 
(क ) और (ख): जी हााँ, स्वास््य और पररवार कल्याण मंत्रालय (एमओएर्एफिब्ल्यू) ने सभी नागररकों के ललए 
ननिःर्ुल्क ओपीिी सेवाएं र् ुरू करने के ललए राष्ट्रीय टेलीमेडिलसन सेवा , ई-संजीवनी नामक एक टेलीमेडिलसन 
एजप्लकेर्न ववकलसत ककया है। यह एजप्लकेर्न नागररक से चर्ककत्सक और चर्ककत्सक से चर्ककत्सक परामर्च के 
ललए टेलीमेडिलसन सेवाएं प्रदान करने के ललए हब और स्पोक मॉिल पर काम करता है।   
   
देर् भर में ओपीिी सेवाएं प्रदान करने के ललए जनवरी , 2022 में ई-संजीवनी प्लेटफॉमच के तहत आयुव ेद 
चर्ककत्सा के ललए ववर्ेषज्ञ ओपीिी और वेलनेस क ें द्र र्ुरू ककए ग ए हैं। अब तक आय ुव ेद ओपीिी में लगभग 
313 चर्ककत्सक पंजीक ृत हैं और 25 आयुव ेद ओपीिी कायचर्ील हैं।  
 
ऑनलाइन आय ुव ेद ओपीिी की स ूर्ी भांलग्नि पर दी गई है।  
     
(ग): प्रश्न नहीं उठता।  
       
(घ): भारत में चर्ककत्सा मूल्य यात्रा (एमवीटी ) को बढावा देने के उद्देश्य से स्वास््य और पररवार कल्याण 
मंत्रालय ने 4 और 5 मार्च, 2022 को एक दहतधारक परामर्च का आयोजन ककया था। परामर्च में सस्ती कीमत 
पर ववश्व स्तरीय स्वास््य सेवाएं देने की क्षमता के साथ भारत को  द ुननया भर में चर्ककत्सा म ूल्य यात्रा के 
ललए एक पसंदीदा गंतव्य  के रूप में उभरने की संभावना पर प्रकार् िाला गया। 
     
दहतधारक परामर्च "हील इन इंडिया " के व्यापक ववषय के तहत ककया गया था , जजसमें ववलभन्न मंत्रालयों और 
संगठनों के प्रनतभाचगयों ने भारतीय पारंपररक चर्ककत्सा के साथ -साथ आधुननक चर्ककत्सा के प्रावधान के 
माध्यम से समग्र स्वास््य और कल्याण सेवाओं सदहत चर्ककत्सा मूल्य यात्रा की क्षमता पर प्रकार् िाला।

2887. श्रीमती रूपा गांग ुली : 
    
क्या आयुष मंत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंगे ककिः 
 
(क ) मंत्रालय द्वारा जीवनशैली में आय ुष को बढावा देने के ललए क्या -क्या कदम उठाए गए हैं , तत्संबंधी 
ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(ख) क्या स्वस्थ आहारों का र्ार्च बनाते समय आयुष को शालमल करने का कोई ववर्ार है ; और   
(ग)  यदद हां , तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है?  
 
उत्तर 
आम ुषयमांत्रीय(श्रीयभर्ाानांदयभोणोवाल) 
(क ):    आयुष मंत्रालय आयुष चर्ककत्सा पद्धततयों के समग्र संवधचन और ववकास के ललए राज्य /संघ राज्य क्षेत्र 
सरकारों के माध्यम से राष्ट्रीय आयुष लमशन (एनएएम) की क ें द्रीय प्रायोजजत योजना का कायाचन्वयन कर रहा 
है।  
 
एनएएम के अंतगचत , आयुष स्वास््य एवं कल्याण केन्द्रों (एर्डब्ल्यूसी) के प्रर्ालन सदहत ववलभन्न 
कायचकलापों के ललए राज्य /संघ राज्य क्षेत्र सरकारों को ववत्तीय सहायता का प्रावधान है।  आयुष एर्डब्ल्यूसी में, 
आयुष चर्ककत्सा पद्धतत के लसद्धांतों और अभ्यासों पर आधाररत एक समग्र कल्याण मॉ डल स्थावपत ककया जा 
रहा है, जजसमें जीवन शैली में आय ुष को बढावा देने सदहत तनवारक , प्रोत्साहक , उपर्ारात्मक, पुनवाचस स्वास््य 
देखभाल पर ध्यान क ें दद्रत ककया जा रहा है । 
 
इसके अततररक्त , एनएएम के आय ुववचद्या घर्क के अंतगचत,  स्कूली बच्र्ों के ललए आय ुष पद्धतत के 
आहार संबंधी लसद्धांतों को शालमल करते ह ुए स्वस्थ जीवन शैली और एकीक ृत आहार लशक्षा को बढावा देने का 
प्रावधान है। इसके अलावा , एनएएम के आय ुष ग्राम घर्क के तहत, व्यवहार में बदलाव के बारे में बताने , 
स्थानीय औषधीय जडी-बूदर्यों की पहर्ान और उपयोग के ललए ग्रामीण स्वास््य कायचकताचओं को  प्रलशक्षण देने 
तथा आयुष स्वास््य सेवाओं का  प्रावधान करके आयुष आधाररत जीवन शैली को बढावा ददया जाता है । 
 
(ख) और (ग): आयुष मंत्रालय, आयुष आधाररत आहार और जीवन शैली  को बढावा दे रहा है और "सुपोवषत 
भारत " (नॅररशड  इंडडया) के अंततम लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने के ललए मदहला एवं  बाल ववकास मंत्रालय के साथ 
लमलकर काम कर रहा है।  
 
आयुष मंत्रालय ने आय ुष अभ्यासों और लसद्धांतों के माध्यम से बच्र्ों , गभचवती मदहलाओं और 
स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं के  
पोषण संबंधी पररणामों में सुधार करने के ललए "क ुपोषण मुक्त भारत के ललए 
आयुष आहार एडवाइजरी " के रूप में समग्र पोषण ददशातनद ेश जारी  ककए हैं ।  
  
     आयुष मंत्रालय ने राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अचधतनयम, 2013 की अन ुसूर्ी-II के तहत तनधाचररत पोषण 
मानकों में संशोधन के ललए खाद्य एवं  सावचजतनक ववतरण ववभाग को जानकारी  भी प्रदान की है ।

क्या आयुष मंत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंगे ककिः 
 
(क ) क्या सरकार ने देश में आय ुष दवाओं पर उन्नत शोध करने के ललए नवीनतम तकनीककयों से 
सुसज्जजत प्रयोगशालाएं स्थापपत की हैं, यदद हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(ख ) सरकार द्वारा आय ुष चर्ककत्सा पद्धतत को लोकपप्रय बनाने के ललए उठाए जा रहे स ुधारात्मक उपायों 
का ब्यौरा क्या है; और    
(ग)  सरकार द्वारा इन प्रयोगशालाओं पर खर्च की गई रालश का ब्यौरा क्या है ? 
  
उत्तर 
आमुषयमांत्रीय(श्रीयभर्ाानांदयभोणोवाि) 
 
(क ): सरकार ने देश में आय ुष औषधों पर उन्नत अन ुसंधान के ललए नवीनतम प्रौद्योचगकी से स ुसज्जजत 
प्रयोगशालाएं स्थापपत की हैं। संबंचधत ब्यौरायभांिग्नि-Iयपर है।  
 
(ख ): आयुष चर्ककत्सा पद्धततयों को लोकपप्रय बनाने के ललए सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए स ुधारात्मक उपायों का 
ब्यौरा भांिग्नि-II 
पर है।  
 
(ग): 
इन प्रयोगशालाओं पर सरकार द्वारा खर्च की गई रालश का ब्यौरा भांिग्नि-III पर है।

454

 
भांिग्नि-I 
देश में आय ुष औषधों पर उन्नत अनुसंधान के ललए नवीनतम प्रौद्योचगकी से स ुसज्जजत प्रयोगशालाओं का 
ब्यौरा।  
I. आयुष मंत्रालय के अधीनस्थ कायाचलय भारतीय चर्ककत्सा एवं होम्योपैथी भेषजसंदहता आयोग 
(पीसीआईएम एंड एर् ), गाज्जयाबाद की स्थापना एएसय ूएंड एर् औषधों के ललए भेषजसंदहतागत 
मानकों  और फामाचयूलरी के पवशेष पववरण को तनधाचररत करके  एएसयू एंड एर् औषधों यके तनधाचरण 
के ललए की गई है।  
II. आमुव ेद 
 
क . आयुष मंत्रालय के तत्वावधान में एक स्वायत्त संगठन क ें द्रीय आयुवेदीय पवज्ञान अनुसंधान पररषद 
(सीसीआरएएस) की देश भर में पांर् अन ुसंधान प्रयोगशालाएं हैं जो आवश्यकतान ुसार इनय हाउभ  
अनुभांधानयिामाििाप करती हैं , नामत :- 
 
i) क्षेत्रीय आयुवेद अन ुसंधान संस्थान, प ुणे (आरएआरआई, पुणे) 
ii) कैंप्टन श्रीतनवास मुती क ें द्रीय आयुवेद अन ुसंधान संस्थान, र्ेन्नई (भीएभएमभीएआरआई, 
चेन्नई) (एनएबीएल द्वारा प्रत्यातयत सुपवधा) 
iii) क्षेत्रीय आयुवेद अन ुसंधान संस्थान, ग्वाललयर (आरएआरआई, ग्वालिमर) 
iv) क ें द्रीय आयुवेद अन ुसंधान संस्थान, कोलकाता (भीएआरआई, िोििाता ) 
v) क ें द्रीय आयुवेद अन ुसंधान संस्थान, झांसी (भीएआरआई, झाांभी) 
 
ख . आयुष मंत्रालय के तत्वावधान में स्वायत्त संगठन आयुवेद लशक्षण एवं अनुसंधान संस्थान (आईटीआरए), 
जामनगर में पवलभन्न पूवच नैदातनक और नैदातनक अन ुसंधान कायच करने के ललए संस्थान के अलभन्न 
अंग के रूप में पैथोलॉजी , जैव रसायन , सूक्ष्म पवज्ञान, भेषजपवज्ञान, भेषजीय रसायन, भेषजअलभज्ञान 
प्रयोगशाला जैसी आधुतनक प्रयोगशालाएं हैं।  
ग. आयुष मंत्रालय के तत्वावधान में स्वायत्त संगठन राष्ट्रीय आयुवेद संस्थान (एनआईए), जयप ुर  की 
औषध आपवष्ट्कार और पवकास इकाई (डीडीडीय ू) के अधीन एक प्रयोगशाला है।   
घ.  आयुष  मंत्रालय के तत्वावधान में स्वायत्त संगठन अखखल भारतीय आय ुवेद संस्थान, नई ददल्ली ने 
अस्पतालों में अत्याधुतनक प्रयोगशाला स ुपवधाएं स्थापपत की हैं । संस्थान में सुसज्जजत पैथोलॉजी , सूक्ष्म 
पवज्ञान और ब्लड बैंक स्थापपत ककया गया है। संस्थान में एर्पीटीएलसी , एएएस सदहत ग ुणवत्ता तनयंत्रण 
प्रयोगशाला और भेषजअलभयान प्रयोगशाला की स ुपवधाएं उपलब्ध हैं।

I. ाारतीमयचचकित्भायऔरयहोम्मोपैथीयाेषजभांहहतायआमोगय(पीभीआईएमयएांडयएच), 
 
पीसीआईएम एंड एर् द्वारा तनधाचररत  एएसयू एंड एर्  औषधों के ललए , भेषजसंदहतागत मानक और 
फामाचयूलरी के पवशेष पववरण औषचध एवं प्रसाधन सामग्री अचधतनयम , 1940 और इसके अंतगचत बनाए 
गए तनयमों के अन ुसार इनमें शालमल एएसय ू एंड एर्  औषधों की पहर्ान , शुद्धता और क्षमता को 
जांर्ने के ललए अचधकाररक सार संग्रह के रूप में कायच करते हैं।

II.  आमुव ेद 
 
क . क ें द्रीय आयुवेदीय पवज्ञान अनुसंधान पररषद (सीसीआरएएस) अपने आईईसी कायचक्रम के जररए 
तनम्नललखखत कायच कर रही है :- 
 
i)  आयुवेद के जररए रोगों के तनवारण और स्वास््य संवधचन पर अंग्रेजी, दहंदी और क्षेत्रीय भाषाओं 
में आम लोगों के ललए ब्रोशर के प्रकाशन द्वारा इलेक्रातनक और पप्रंट मीडडया के मायमयम से लोगों के 
बीर् आयुवेद चर्ककत्सा पद्धतत को लोकपप्रय बनाना।   
ii) इन्हें राष्ट्रीय/राजय स्तर के आरोग्य मेलों , स्वास््य लशपवरों, प्रदशचतनयों, संगोज्ष्ट्ठयों, वेबबनार , 
सावचजतनक व्याख्यानों इत्यादद के साथ -साथ सीसीआरएएस के पह ुंर् संबंधी कायचक्रमों नामत : अनुसूचर्त 
जातत उपयोजना (एससीएसपी) अनुसंधान कायचक्रम, जनजातीय स्वास््य पररर्याच अनुसंधान कायचक्रम 
(टीएर्सीआरपी ), प ूवोत्तर योजना आदद के मायमयम से देश के पवलभन्न राजयों में व्यापक रूप से पवतररत 
ककया जाता है।  इसके अलावा, ये ब्रोशर पररषद की वेबसाइट में भी व्यापक प्रसार के ललए अपलोड ककए 
जाते हैं।   
iii) पररषद जनता की व्यापक उपयोचगता के  ललए समार्ार पत्रों में पवज्ञापनों और पररषद की 
वेबसाइट के मायमयम से भी चर्क ुनगुतनया, डेंगु, फ्लू जैसी बीमारी आदद जैसे रोगों की रोकथाम और 
प्रबंधन के ललए एडवाइजरी भी जारी करती है।   
iv) पररषद आयुष अनुसंधान पोटचल नामक एक वेबसाइट का रख रखाव करती  है ज्जसमें अनुसंधान 
की व्यापक उपयोचगता और दृष्ट्यता के ललए सभी आय ुष चर्ककत्सा पद्धततयों से संबंचधत प्रत्येक प्रकालशत 
अनुसंधान सूर्ना व्यवज्स्थत रूप से अपलोड की जाती है। अभी तक 34,324 शोध पत्र/सार पोटचल पर 
अपलोड ककए गए हैं। पररषद की वेबसाइट में सामान्य रूप से आ युवेद संबंधी स ूर्ना भी उपलब्ध है और 
अन्य महत्वपूणच वेबसाइटों के साथ हाइपरललंक्ड है जो व्यापक रूप से उपयोचगता के ललए स ूर्ना प्रदान 
करता है।

पद्धतत को लोकपप्रय बना रही है। इसके अततररक्त स्क ूल स्वास््य कायचक्रम और नैदातनक र्ल अन ुसंधान

र्लाया जा रहा है। इस कायचक्रम के अंतगचत, पररषद के पवलभन्न क ें द्रों के मायमयम से पवलभन्न रोगों के
